text:
maria: Heads up — canary is reporting ~30% token/sec drop after the PR #4851 merge. Latency p95 spiked and throughput down across small and medium models. deploy-bot: rollout paused on canary cluster #7 :warning:
lee: saw this too, reproducing locally with the same load profile. coalescer queue length climbs and then drains slowly.
jordan: summary from profiler (quick): lots of time in kernel fallback path and many oversized batches hitting generic matmul.
samir: any relation to the coalescing changes in #4851? that PR bumped coalesce_window_ms from 4 -> 12 for improved latency amortization.
maria: that's the suspect — larger window seems to create occasional fat batches beyond the tuned kernel thresholds for sequence len ~1024. kernels choose fallback path.
alicia: also noticed kv cache hitrate down from 78% -> 49% on the same canary runs. maybe unrelated but worth checking.
lee: ran a perf-record and pprof; flame snippet:```flamegraph
samples: 1200
kernel_select -> generic_matmul 48%\nruntime_batcher -> coalescer_drain 22%\nkv_lookup -> hash_trim 8%\nother 22%```
jordan: thanks. that matches the observed hotspot. generic_matmul is ~2.2x slower than our optimized fused attention kernel for these batch shapes.
samir: kicked off git bisect locally. first bad commit points to 7a3f9e4 which is the coalescer prioritize-by-model change + coalesce window bump (PR #4851).
maria: good catch. any quick mitigation we can deploy without full revert? maybe cap max_batch_tokens or force kernel selection threshold tweak.
lee: tried limiting max_batch_tokens to 16384 on canary — token/sec partially recovers (~15% loss remains). direct kernel threshold tweak fixes throughput but increases p95 for tiny requests. tradeoff.
ci-bot: perf/throughput check failed for release/edge (regression +18% tokens/sec drop) — blocking merge.
alicia: kv hitrate issue looks like a separate bug: PR #4868 unintentionally changed the kv shard key hash salt, causing miss rate. filing a hotfix.
jordan: plan: (1) revert the coalesce_window bump in a small rollback PR to restore previous batch sizes, (2) backport kv-hash hotfix, (3) run canary with max_batch_tokens cap and kernel-threshold tweak, (4) re-evaluate.
samir: I'm preparing 7a3f9e4-revert-quick (PR #4872). requesting hold on rollout until canary green.
maria: agreed — put rollout on hold. can someone add notes to the rollout tracker? alicia, can you handle kv hotfix?
alicia: on it, creating #4869-kv-hash-hotfix now.
lee: after revert + kv-fix i'll run full perf matrix (seq len 128/512/1024) and attach pprof and nvidia-smi logs.
maria: thanks. TL;DR: regression introduced by coalescer change (7a3f9e4 / PR #4851) causes fat batches -> kernel fallback -> token/sec drop; separate kv salt change causing hitrate drop. revert + hotfix + cap should be quick mitigation.
deploy-bot: rollback PR #4872 created and queued for canary.
ci-bot: perf gate re-run scheduled. will post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
lee: FYI commands I ran:```bash
git checkout release/edge
git bisect start -- bad commit 7a0000 && git bisect bad 7a3f9e4
perf record -g -- ./run_load_test.sh --config canary.json
pprof -http=:6060 perf.data
nvidia-smi dmon -s u -o TD```
jordan: thanks — keep thread updated, especially if canary still shows p99 spikes after rollback.
maria: will monitor.
